crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”
Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day…

translations.web: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
translations.bsb: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
translations.kjv: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
translations.asv: And David was displeased, because Jehovah had broken forth upon Uzza; and he called that place Perez-uzza, unto this day.
